title: Answer a booking request
summary: The request waiting longest first: review the renter, dates and car, then send the offer.

steps.text: Open Requests and offers: the most urgent request is first.
Press Send offer on the request waiting longest. Reply within the target time.
Check the renter, the dates and the car they asked for. Change the car if it is not free.
Add a short message for the renter (optional).
Press Send the offer. The renter gets the link to approve, sign and pay.
